title: Unit – 4 : Session – 6 : SLO – 2  |  Parallel Computing — Architecture Matching
sections: 1. Shared Memory — Common address space: all processors read/write one global memory.
2. Distributed Memory — Message passing: each node has private memory; data moves via explicit send/receive (MPI).
3. Multicore CPU — Parallel execution units: several cores on one chip execute threads simultaneously.
Flynn's taxonomy context: multicore CPUs and shared-memory machines are typically MIMD systems.
Hybrid systems combine both: clusters of multicore nodes use shared memory inside a node and message passing across nodes.
